title: Price Drop Wait-Time Before Purchase
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pricetrack:alert
| search purchase_delay_days=*
| stats avg(purchase_delay_days) as avg_purchase_delay_days perc90(purchase_delay_days) as p90_purchase_delay_days count as samples by category
| sort 0 - avg_purchase_delay_days
description: Measures wait time from price drop to purchase by category.
value: Wait time reveals whether alerts are helping you buy deliberately or simply giving you more things to watch.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for wait time from price drop to purchase to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 wait time from price drop to purchase.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long wait time from price drop to purchase usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
